disqualification_flags.text: transient status and inner-success count use unsupported success criteria
disqualification_flags.evidence: Immutable solver/src/solver.cpp:55–62 unconditionally sets transient status statistically_periodic and completed=true; :743–748 caps maximum inner iterations at 15, and :845–852 counts a miss only when ratio >=1 rather than the configured 1e-3. The prior evaluation recorded last ratio 0.928488 and a 97.56% success fraction; that fraction uses the wrong threshold. The original raw metadata is not currently available in the workspace, and this evidence does not establish the proportion of steps that missed 1e-3.
